description: Create a transaction — card (raw, stored, or Apple Pay/Google Pay) or PIX. For card, either: (1) "session-first" — call create_3ds_session first and pass its id as three_d_secure_session_id; or (2) "transaction-first" — pass require_3ds: true and the transaction comes back AWAITING_3DS, then call authenticate_transaction. For PIX, set payment_method: "PIX" and fill pix_data + consumer; the transaction comes back WAITING_PAYMENT with a QR code.

card_data.description: Card or digital wallet used for this transaction. For a raw card, set number+cvv (both pre-encrypted). For Apple Pay / Google Pay, set network_token+cryptogram+wallet_type instead. Omit entirely if paying via card_id.

cryptogram.description: Wallet cryptogram, for Apple Pay / Google Pay. PRE-ENCRYPTED by the rinne-js Card Element in the browser (format "ev:..."). Rinne rejects raw/plaintext card numbers and CVVs with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR — there is no server-side encryption path. Run a rinne-js checkout flow first to obtain this token, then pass it here to finalize server-side. See get_sandbox_guide.

cvv.description: CVV, for raw-card payment. PRE-ENCRYPTED by the rinne-js Card Element in the browser (format "ev:..."). Rinne rejects raw/plaintext card numbers and CVVs with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR — there is no server-side encryption path. Run a rinne-js checkout flow first to obtain this token, then pass it here to finalize server-side. See get_sandbox_guide.

network_token.description: Device network token, for Apple Pay / Google Pay. PRE-ENCRYPTED by the rinne-js Card Element in the browser (format "ev:..."). Rinne rejects raw/plaintext card numbers and CVVs with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR — there is no server-side encryption path. Run a rinne-js checkout flow first to obtain this token, then pass it here to finalize server-side. See get_sandbox_guide.

number.description: Card number, for raw-card payment. PRE-ENCRYPTED by the rinne-js Card Element in the browser (format "ev:..."). Rinne rejects raw/plaintext card numbers and CVVs with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR — there is no server-side encryption path. Run a rinne-js checkout flow first to obtain this token, then pass it here to finalize server-side. See get_sandbox_guide.

card_id.description: Card only — use a card previously saved via store_card instead of card_data

consumer.description: Payer/buyer identification. Required for PIX; optional for card.

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID to scope this call to (uses /v1/merchants/{merchant_id}/...). Omit to act at the organization/self level with an org-scoped key.

pix_data.description: PIX charge details, for payment_method: PIX.

due_date.description: ISO date — for a PIX-with-due-date (bolepix) charge instead of immediate

expiration_in_seconds.description: For an immediate PIX charge (QR code)

provider.description: Processing provider — RINNE by default, or a provider this merchant has an active affiliation with (e.g. CAPPTA, CELCOIN)

request_id.description: Your idempotency key for this transaction

require_3ds.description: Card only — transaction-first flow: force 3DS, returns AWAITING_3DS for authenticate_transaction

three_d_secure_session_id.description: Card only — id from create_3ds_session (session-first flow)

name: create_transaction
